article_framing_rejections.headline: Port St. Lucie shooting that killed two men captured in 911 calls

lead_independence.headline: Port St. Lucie shooting that killed two men captured in 911 calls
lead_independence.lead: Multiple callers contacted dispatchers shortly before 3:30 a.m. July 19 after hearing repeated gunshots near Southeast Rivergreen Circle. One caller pleaded for help as a wounded man faded in front of her, repeatedly urging him to remain conscious. Officers responding to the scene found 24-year-old Carl Loubeau and 22-year-old Juliun Stokes suffering from multiple gunshot wounds. Both were taken to hospitals, where they later died.

article_framing_rejections.headline: Okeechobee High School prepares to open new $107 million building

lead_independence.headline: Okeechobee High School prepares to open new $107 million building
lead_independence.lead: The new building at Okeechobee High School features 85 classrooms and room for up to 1,700 students. Superintendent Dylan Tedders gave a tour of the facility Thursday, highlighting the upgrades from the previous high school, which was built in the 1960s. The new building will be the first time all of Okeechobee's high school students can learn from the same campus. Previously, freshmen attended a separate campus.

article_framing_rejections.headline: Boca Raton approves over $1 million for four new police officers to address homelessness

lead_independence.headline: Boca Raton approves over $1 million for four new police officers to address homelessness
lead_independence.lead: Boca Raton city leaders directed City Manager Mark Sohaney to move forward with hiring four new police officers, a Community Resource Coordinator, and creating a Quality of Life Working Group during a Monday workshop. The four new officers will cost approximately $280,000 each, totaling about $1.12 million, while the Community Resource Coordinator position will cost about $110,000.
